name: HTTPS and WWW Redirect
description: Allows for easy configuration of HTTPS and WWW redirects.
project_description:
This module simplifies the process of setting a preferred URL and is designed for users who wish to enforce SSL and/or a specific domain without having to edit any files. It operates on a "set it and forget it" basis.

 Users can choose to enable mixed mode, which permits both HTTP and HTTPS, or to require HTTPS exclusively. They may also choose to redirect users to their preferred domain, either with or without the WWW subdomain (prefix). These changes do not require any code modifications.

 The module is not domain-specific, meaning that the same configuration settings can be applied to multiple domains or instances.

 The redirect uses a "301 Moved Permanently" HTTP response status code.

 
 Important note 
 If you choose to enable HTTPS redirection, this module requires a pre-configured SSL certificate setup in order for HTTPS to work properly.

 
 Recommended module 
 RobotsTxt 

Let Drupal manage the robots.txt file, and take advantage of the features provided by the HTTPS and WWW Redirect module.
